title: LEARN GLOBALLY, SPEAK LOCALLY: BRIDGING THE GAPS IN MULTILINGUAL REASONING
benchmark_measurement: The GEOFACT-X benchmark measures factual knowledge of religious concepts, figures, places, and events as one of ten topics. Questions are culturally grounded in the context of five specific countries: USA, India, Japan, Kenya, and Thailand.
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings related to religion. The performance evaluation on the GEOFACT-X benchmark is aggregated across all ten topics (including religion, history, politics, etc.), and no topic-specific analysis is presented.
